nodes.title: Winning Red & White Boxing Gloves | Classic Two-Tone Training Gloves
nodes.descriptionHtml:

What you get

nodes.title: Pink Winning Boxing Gloves | Bold Leather Training Gloves 8oz-16oz
nodes.descriptionHtml:
Pink gloves tend to prompt the same few questions, so let us answer them directly for this Winning Pink pair.

Is it a serious glove?

Yes. Only the colour changes. It is offered in the same range of weights, from 6oz to 18oz, and the same closures, Lace-Up and Velcro, as every other colour.

Is it only for women?

No. It is unisex adult, so anyone who likes the colour can use it.

Will pink fade?

Pinks and reds fade faster in direct sunlight. Keep the gloves in a bag and wipe them after use.

Which weight should I choose?

Use 12oz for general training and 16oz for sparring. Lighter weights suit speed work and smaller hands.

Can I get more than one shade?

Yes. For a softer pair, see the White & Dark Pink. For something bolder, see the Pink & Purple. All styles: Winning boxing gloves collection.

nodes.descriptionHtml:
White Winning gloves are for boxers who value a crisp look and honest feedback. White leather shows contact marks and scuffs, so it doubles as a record of where your punches land, but it also asks for care. Here is what to expect before you buy.

What you gain

  • A clean, classic appearance that goes with any kit
  • Visible feedback on knuckle alignment and contact
  • A pair that stands out among dark gear

What it asks of you

Wipe the gloves after each session and air-dry them open. Skip that for weeks and light leather greys in a way that does not fully reverse.

Sizes and closures

From 6oz to 18oz, in Lace-Up or Velcro. For sparring, 16oz Lace-Up is the usual choice; for solo bag work, 12oz Velcro is easy to use.

Lower-maintenance alternatives

Try the Silver & White for a bright look with a little contrast, or the Black for a pair that hides everything. See the Winning gloves collection.

  • Pad work with a coach: 10oz or 12oz, Lace-Up
  • Sparring: 16oz or 18oz, Lace-Up
  • Speed days: 6oz-8oz as a second pair

Why does black look new for longer?

Dark leather hides chalk, bag dust and light scuffs better than any other colour, so maintenance is a wipe and an air-dry.

If you want a little more personality

  • Pad work, where the holder needs to read your hands quickly

Yellow fades in direct sun and shows marks more than darker colours. Wipe the gloves after use and store them in a bag, away from windows.

Metallic finishes dull when they get wet. Wipe the gloves with a soft dry cloth after each session and avoid sprays or damp wipes.

Lace-Up or Velcro?

Lace-Up keeps the cleanest line against gold and gives the firmest hold. Velcro is faster when you train alone.
